verdict.rationale: Windmill documents programmatic entry points: webhook endpoints for scripts and flows, including version-pinned flow webhooks, plus HTTP-route triggers. Scoped user tokens authenticate that access, and the `wmill` CLI and MCP server both interact with instances. However, the pack has no general documented REST API reference for managing the product, and probes for an OpenAPI spec at common paths on windmill.dev all returned 404. missing for 10: a documented general-purpose public REST API reference covering resource management (not just triggering runs), a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, independent hands-on corroboration of API use.
